title: Monitors: best mode automatically on hotplug
objective: A systemd user service keeps every connected monitor at its native resolution and highest refresh rate, DP-0 primary and leftmost, others to its right, re-applied whenever a monitor is connected or disconnected.
acceptance_criteria: plan() turns the 2026-11-11 DP-0-off state into DP-0 3840x2160@144 at 0x0 plus HDMI-0 2560x1440@143.98 at 3840x0, and returns [] when already there
The watcher handles one burst of output events with one apply, survives a failed xrandr, and waits for late EDID modes
setup_monitor_autoconfig.sh leaves monitor-autoconfig.service enabled and active
out_of_scope: Undoing deliberate mode changes by games or manual xrandr
